text: Chain requests together, extracting values from one response to use in another
quote: Insomnia provides the ability to chain requests. This means you can extract values from the responses of other requests while also sharing state across requests.

text: Write pre-request scripts to manipulate variables, auth, or request contents before sending
quote: Pre-request scripts allow you to execute tasks before a request is sent. They can be used to: * Manipulate environment variables or authentication * Manipulate the contents of the request

text: Automate execution of API tests via a CLI integrated into existing Git workflows
quote: Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.

text: Run automated tests across multiple requests in a collection with unlimited collection runs
quote: Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.

text: Design and iterate on OpenAPI specs directly inside the product
quote: Build and iterate on your OpenAPI specs to design your next API.

text: Create a cloud-hosted mock endpoint in a few steps
quote: The Insomnia Cloud mock servers allow you to create a mock endpoint in a few steps.

text: Send gRPC requests from a collection
quote: Insomnia supports making gRPC requests.

text: Import and export Postman, HAR, OpenAPI, Swagger, WSDL, and cURL formats
quote: Import formats: Insomnia JSON (v4), Insomnia YAML (v5), Postman v2.0/v2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, and cURL

text: Define reusable groups of variables (environments) applied across requests, e.g. base URLs, tokens
quote: Use environments to define groups of variables that Insomnia applies across your requests. For example, you could create variables for base URLs, tokens, or credentials.

text: Auto-generate a mock server from a natural-language prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL
quote: Creates a mock server from a prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL response. Automatically scaffolds routes, responses, and configurations.

text: Sync collections with any third-party Git repository without going through a cloud service
quote: Git Sync: for Git storage using any 3rd party Git repository, without going through the cloud.

text: Apply role-based access control for fine-grained permissions over Insomnia resources
quote: Use Role-based access control (RBAC) for fine-grain control over who can access which Insomnia resources.

text: Share collections and environments securely with colleagues via organizations
quote: Insomnia organizations allows users to share collections and environments safely and securely with their colleagues.

text: Automatically stores and resends cookies across requests like a browser
quote: Insomnia automatically stores cookies from every response and sends them with future requests as needed, just like a web browser.

text: Connect via MCP clients to Konnect for real-time mocking, validating, and protecting requests
quote: Use MCP clients to connect Insomnia to Konnect for mocking, validating, and protecting requests in real time.

text: Send requests over HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets
quote: With Insomnia, you can send requests via HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets.

text: Preview a generated rendering of your API spec alongside the editor
quote: View a generated preview of your spec in the right pane.

text: Automatically lint specs and surface errors with type, line number, and message
quote: Automatically linted. Errors display at the bottom of the center pane and include error type, line number, and error message

text: Generate code snippets automatically in 12+ programming languages
quote: Generate code snippets automatically in over 12 different programming languages.

text: Use the Collection Runner to send multiple requests in a defined order
quote: Use the Collection Runner to send multiple requests in a specific order

text: Resolve Git merge conflicts in a built-in merge view without leaving the app
quote: Insomnia opens a merge view so you can review and resolve conflicts without leaving the app.

text: Integrate with external vault providers to auto-retrieve secret values when sending requests
quote: Insomnia supports integrating with external vault service providers to retrieve secret values automatically when sending requests.

text: Provide GraphQL auto-completion and linting via the schema type system
quote: Insomnia uses this type system to provide auto-completion and linting of GraphQL queries.

text: Upload Protobuf files (single file or directory) to a gRPC request
quote: Insomnia allows you to upload Protobuf files to a request. You can upload a single file or a directory containing multiple files.

text: Dynamic mocking renders Liquid templates so mock responses can include request data or fake data
quote: Dynamic mocking extends Insomnia’s existing mock server feature. For each request, dynamic mocking renders Liquid templates so responses can include...

text: MCP Client discovers server-exposed tools/prompts/resources so they can be invoked, queried, or tested in-app
quote: The Insomnia MCP Client discovers these elements, which enables you to invoke, query, or test them directly in the app.

text: Scratch Pad mode works fully without ever requiring login
quote: No login ever required for Scratch Pad

text: Convert a project's storage between Local Vault, Cloud Sync, or Git Sync
quote: You can convert a project to: Local Vault, Cloud Sync, Git Sync

text: Insomnia's own servers cannot read or access sensitive project data during sync
quote: At no point in the sync process can the Insomnia servers read or access sensitive application project data.

text: AI suggests commit messages to keep Git history clear and atomic
quote: AI commit message suggestions, which help maintain clear and atomic commit histories.

text: Extend functionality with unlimited plugins or build your own
quote: Unlimited access to plugins or build your own

text: Import existing test suites directly from Postman
quote: Import your tests from Postman

text: Collaboratively build APIs with unlimited contributors plus git version control
quote: Collaboratively create APIs with an unlimited number of contributors (free accounts allow unlimited contributors on one project) and git version control.

text: Connect external MCP servers to access AI-ready tools, prompts, and resources
quote: Use Insomnia to connect external Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers to access AI-ready tools, prompts, and resources.

text: Support SSO login via any SAML 2.0-compatible identity provider
quote: You can use any identity provider (IdP) that supports SAML 2.0.

text: Import a Postman collection or OpenAPI spec via UI File/Clipboard/URL
quote:
Import a Postman collection or OpenAPI spec into Insomnia
Method: UI → Import → choose File/Clipboard/URL.

text: Lint OpenAPI specs in CI with inso lint spec, failing the build on errors
quote: In CI, use inso lint spec <identifier> to lint OpenAPI and fail builds on errors.

text: Inso CLI is built for CI: disables prompts and returns pass/fail exit codes
quote: Inso CLI is designed to run in a Continuous Integration (CI) environment. It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.

quote:
Global environments, which can be accessed by all collections in a project

* Folder environments

text: Unlimited environments available per project
quote:
Unlimited collection runs

quote: Users can deploy self-hosted mock servers using Insomnia Mockbin. This allows you to have more control over usage for your mocks.
